newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Security completes Golston buy.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Security completes Golston buy.

text.p: Integrated Security Systems Inc said Friday it had completed its acquisition of Golston Co, a maker of specialty products for the financial and healthcare industries. The deal closed on December 31.
Integrated Security said it bought Golston's stock for $4.8 million of cash and seller notes, and assumed about $650,000 in debt.
Golston's real estate and facilities were acquired for an additional $1.5 million cash, the company said.

Integrated Security said it funded the deal by selling $4.6 million of convertible debentures to two funds advised by Renaissance Capital Group Inc. The debentures have a maturity of seven years, and, until converted, carry an annual interest rate of nine percent.

No principal payments are due on the debentures during the first three years, Integrated Security said. The debentures may be exchanged for Integrated Security common stock at a conversion price of $1.05 per share, it said.
The company said it also conducted a private placement of its shares, raising $660,000.
